description: Get a coin's options open interest on Deribit, OKX, Bybit and Binance (hourly): totals per venue, by expiry with put/call ratio and max pain, by strike (one expiry or all), each venue's hourly history, and the options-to-futures open interest ratio. US dollars, one side; Deribit's reading is 8 hours older (it publishes open interest 8 hours late). History starts 2026-11-17.

coin.description: Base coin ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ...).

exchange.description: One venue; every venue when omitted.

expiry.description: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) whose options `strikes` lists; every expiry when omitted.

name: get_options_open_interest
title: Options open interest
